36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
141457: Momo Chiyoda is the magical girl who is protecting the town of Seiiki Sakuraga-oka. As a magical girl, she is a maniac of muscle training, and her physical power overwhelmingly surpasses that of her rival Yuuko, the succubus in town.
141458: Mikan Hinatsuki is a Magical Girl who arrives in town to support Momo. She suffers from a curse that brings misfortune to those close to her whenever she gets overly excited or anxious.
141459: Seiko Yoshida is Yuuko and Ryouko's mother.
141460: Lilith is Yuuko's demon ancestor. She appears in her dreams one night and gives her demon powers, and tasks her on defeating a magical girl.
141461: Yuuko Yoshida is a demon whose power is suddenly awakened in her first year of high school; aims to overthrow the magical girl in town to break her family's spell.
141462: Ryouko Yoshida is Yuuko's younger sister. Ryouko's dream is to support her sister in becoming a fearsome demon.
141463: Anri Sata is Yuuko's friend and classmate.
141464: Shion Ogura is Yuuko's friend and classmate.
287030: Momo Chiyoda's "navigator", one of many familiars that provides guidance to magical girls of the Light Clan.
287308: A lady who owns a dog which always seems to bark at Yuuko or her apartment whenever they're close by.
